meta.objective: Compile a compile-only workflow that defines the remaining engine-stability hardening program: per-work-unit retry semantics in engine settings, deterministic fault injection for chaos testing, final observability and forensic gaps, and the complete test/signoff matrix required before calling the engine stable.

decisions: Treat per-work-unit retries as a first-class engine-settings contract.
Use deterministic fault injection rather than purely random failures for initial chaos validation.
Separate operational stability signoff from scientific-validity signoff; both must be represented in the final gate.
